name: commonality
cmd: set -e; for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1995_s1_late desk_tempho_1985_s1 desk_tempho_1985_s1_late desk_tempho_1995_s2 desk_tempho_1995_s2_late desk_tempho_1985_s2 desk_tempho_1985_s2_late; do {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/$c --out {out}/$c --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --strong-base --commonality --tag _common; done
summarize: for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1995_s1_late desk_tempho_1985_s1 desk_tempho_1985_s1_late desk_tempho_1995_s2 desk_tempho_1995_s2_late desk_tempho_1985_s2 desk_tempho_1985_s2_late; do echo == $c; {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --summarize {out}/$c | grep -E 'COMMONALITY'; done
note: E044: commonality of the regional-trend placebo with covariate-only predictors (linear maps, DESK) on held-out community change
